seo_title: Pizza delivery to Saryarka district — Frnds, Astana
seo_description: Living in the Saryarka district? No need to cross the river: Frnds couriers bring pizza over the bridge hot, in thermal bags. WhatsApp +7 707 480 92 15.
h1: Saryarka: come over as a guest — or let the courier cross the bridge
body:
If you live in the Saryarka district, the left bank usually means business rather than food: a meeting, paperwork, a queue at some office, an appointment at a place you didn't choose. Since you're on this side around lunchtime anyway — drop in. We're in the Esil district at 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street, working every day from nine in the morning to eleven at night, with no break that starts exactly the moment you arrive. One door, a visible sign, and the courtyards nearby are the easiest place to leave the car.

What to order depends on how much time you've got. Almost none — ask for a panuozzo: it's our own pizza dough folded so you can hold it in one hand and eat on the move, or in the car before the next meeting. Plenty — start with a soup, follow with a pizza, add a dessert and stop watching the clock: closing time is still far away. And if your morning happened closer to the evening today, the kitchen won't blink — breakfast here is cooked the entire time the door is open, and nobody asks why you want an omelette at six.

Now the main thing: you no longer have to come to us at all. Frnds has its own delivery — not a partner service, properly ours, with Frnds couriers and branded thermal bags that keep the order hot on the road. The bridge between Saryarka and the left bank sees those bags regularly, in both directions and in any weather. Write to WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 — what to make and where to bring it — and dinner will end at your door instead of our till.

So the choice is finally a fair one. Got business on the left bank — come in person: sit in the dining room, watch the open kitchen at work, take your order with you if you're hurrying back. No business — stay in your own district and wait for the courier's call. There is no wrong option between the two. What's coming out of the oven today is on Instagram at @frnds.kz, and from nine in the morning till eleven at night we cook for both sides of the river at once.
landmarks: We're across the river from the Congress Hall and the Nurly Zhol station: left bank, Esil district, 25 Sagadat Nurmagambetov Street. Though if you order delivery, it's the courier who needs the address, not you.
cta: Don't wait for business to drag you across the river again — message WhatsApp at +7 707 480 92 15 and the courier will take the bridge for you.
